title: A sharp stability inequality of Liouville's theorem for quasiregular mappings on bounded domains
summary: Let $n \ge 3$ and fix $p>n$. We establish a sharp quantitative stability result in $W^{1,p}$ for Liouville's theorem for nonconstant, sense-preserving quasiregular mappings whose outer distortion $K$ is sufficiently close to one. We first reorganize Reshetnyak's classical local argument \cite{R1976}, drawing systematically on modern techniques such as those developed in \cite{FZ2022}. We then give two globalization schemes on bounded, connected domains.
